'''RE-1''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] which existed during the time of a [[Third Galactic War|galactic conflict]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Fallen Order" />

==Behind the scenes==
RE-1 was first introduced in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a mini-pet companion given to players between November 14th, 2019 to December 10th, 2019, in celebration of the release of [[Respawn Entertainment]]'s ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''. The droid was based off early unused concept artwork of the [[canon]] droid character [[BD-1]]. The game's developers worked with Respawn to make sure RE-1 was properly influenced by BD-1 whilst fitting with the Old Republic era.<ref name="Fallen Order" />
